_help: Fish Audio voices for each speaker. Each id is the code at the end of the voice's page address on fish.audio (https://fish.audio/m/<id>). All are Fish Audio's own official voices, the same family used in Church Mind and The Pilgrim's Progress. 'page' (story pages read aloud) uses the narrator's voice if left empty. Your API key goes in the FISH_API_KEY environment variable, never in this file. 's2.1-pro-free' is Fish Audio's free developer tier, as in the other games.

_who.narrator: Richard: British storyteller (the Dreamer in The Pilgrim's Progress). Also reads the story pages
_who.note: Sarah: soft, intimate, sincere. Wayfinder's gentle notes, including safety notes
_who.hanan: Abel: warm man, slowed a little. Elijah journey's fellow traveller
_who.abiel: Hollis: warm, natural man. Gideon journey's farmer
_who.miri: Maeve: warm British woman. Naomi journey's widow
_who.sefa: Amara: Nigerian English woman, clear and confident. Hagar journey's spring keeper
_who.iry: Chidi: Nigerian English man, clear and warm. Joseph journey's fellow prisoner
_who.yona: Megan: London woman, warm and plain-spoken. Peter journey's net mender
_who.tavi: Miles: relaxed young man. David journey's court musician
_who.nathan: Jordan: older man, measured and assured. Nathan the prophet
_who.ziva: Delia: confident woman. Samson journey's vineyard keeper
